deadline.value: All applicants must apply by November 12, 2026 (11:59 pm PT).
deadline.quote: The deadline for ALL 2027 applicants is November 12, 2026 (11:59 pm PT).

gre_general.value: GRE scores are not required or accepted.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are not required or accepted for the Graduate Program in Neuroscience.

gre_subject.value: GRE scores (including subject tests) are not considered.
gre_subject.quote: We do not consider or accept GRE scores.

fee_waiver.value: The program has no waiver; only the Graduate School's need-based waiver, which excludes F-1/J-1 applicants.
fee_waiver.quote: The Neuroscience program does not offer a fee waiver. However, there is a need-based fee-waiver process through the central graduate school.

supervisor.value: You list five faculty of interest for interviews, then do three lab rotations in year one before choosing a lab.
supervisor.quote: Interviewing with a faculty member does not obligate an applicant to rotate in that person’s lab. First-year students complete three laboratory rotations

funding.value: Full tuition and stipend support is guaranteed for all entering students; after year one the lab PI funds you if you make satisfactory progress.
funding.quote: our Program guarantees full tuition and stipend support for all entering students | Neuroscience students who maintain full-time enrollment and satisfactory progress in the program are supported with a salary and/or stipend/fellowship and their tuition is covered.

entry_route.value: Bachelor's or master's holders in neuroscience, biology, maths, physics, CS or engineering can apply; at least 12 months of research experience is required.
entry_route.quote: including those with undergraduate or a Master degrees in neuroscience, biology, math, physics, computer science, or engineering. | Applicants must have a minimum of 12 months of research experience.

notes: Finalists interview virtually in early 2027; offers go out around February 17-19.
